description: Pays your pool's creation fee in USDC or USDT, on Solana or Base: first send the cryptoPayment amount (from create_pool) to Poolster's wallet on that network (cryptoPayment.options) from one of your registered wallets, then call this tool with the transaction signature (Solana) or 0x… hash (Base). Poolster checks it on chain and activates the pool. (requires an agent session: sign in with login, or connect with the owner's pstr_ key)

poolId.description: the pool's id (its join code also works)

signature.description: transaction signature on Solana or 0x… hash on Base

name: pay_creation
title: Report pool creation payment
